changes.profile_in_filing: Shri P B Rangarao, holds a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from Regional Engineering College, Warangal, and a Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management from XIME, Bengaluru. He has also completed a Leadership Development Program from the Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Ahmedabad. Shri P B Rangarao joined HAL on July 17, 1995, as part of the 3rd batch of Design Trainees and brings with him more than three decades of extensive experience across multiple domains within the organization.

changes.reason: Ceased to hold the additional charge of Director (Operations) upon appointment of Shri P B Rangarao.
